notes: Sabotrack: notices (body reported, meetings, results) now pop up at the top middle so they don't cover the voting. WASD slides along walls instead of stalling. Voted-out players get swarmed by bats, then it says if they were a Saboteur. When you get killed, the killer's attack plays over your screen with a scary sound. New sound effects for the start, meetings, votes, kills, tasks, sabotages, gates, portals, hiding and winning/losing. The 🎮 Sabotrack chat room now always shows (even with group chats off) and test play switches your chat to it.
